description: Batch C validation plan, separate from the core, Batch A and Batch B plans. Every reference marked required is required: an absent, undeclared or incomplete reference FAILS; unmatched, duplicated or blank keys, missing required columns, record-count mismatches, non-finite disagreements and unclassified comparisons FAIL. The reference is a column selection of the authoritative frozen V1.4 aggregate output primary_resampling_summary.csv (rows with target_type = primary_cumulative); no output of the new package is a reference. Tolerances are the existing named set 'cumulative' (exact 1e-12; within 1e-7 abs + 1e-6 rel); none is changed or added. Integer counts (replicates_successful) are compared under the same rule, i.e. they must agree exactly.
